units.one_line: The libp2p networking layer: it runs the QUIC swarm and translates between network messages and EventBus events.

actors.name: Libp2pNetInterface
actors.role: Not an actix actor: a tokio task that owns the swarm, emits NetEvents and applies NetCommands.

actors.name: DocumentPublisher
actors.role: Announces the documents this node publishes (DHT store plus gossip notice), uploads replicas, and fetches documents that peers name.

actors.name: NetEventTranslator
actors.role: Gossips this node's forwardable events and publishes accepted peer events to the bus as remote events.

actors.name: NetEventBuffer
actors.role: Holds application network events during startup and releases them, then a marker, when SyncEnded arrives.

actors.name: NetSyncManager
actors.role: Serves historical-sync requests from the EventStore, fetches peer history at startup, publishes NetReady, and re-gossips in-flight DKG and share messages after a restart.

actors.name: EventConverter
actors.role: Turns this node's key artifacts into PublishDocumentRequested events, and received documents back into typed events.

consumes.name: all bus events, filtered to the forwardable allowlist

emits.name: ThresholdShareCreated, EncryptionKeyReceived, DecryptionKeyShared (decoded from a document)

state.name: libp2p identity keypair, stored encrypted and decrypted on start
Kademlia record store holding DHT documents (25 MiB value cap)
publications waiting to be announced and uploaded
documents received after restart, kept until SyncEnded
inbound DHT replicas by sender, bounded per peer and in total
application network events held during startup
seen message and event IDs, six-hour window
sent and stored event IDs for translator deduplication

key_types.name: NodeBehaviour
key_types.what: Combined libp2p behaviour: gossipsub, Kademlia, request-response, identify, connection limits.

key_types.name: NetworkPolicy
key_types.what: Network profile, protocol names and deployment map; peers' Identify data is checked against the protocol names.

key_types.name: GOSSIP_WIRE_MAJOR
key_types.what: Gossip wire major (5): in the gossip topic name and the envelope schema version. SYNC_WIRE_MAJOR (4) does the same for sync.

key_types.name: GossipWireEnvelope
key_types.what: Gossip frame with magic IFG3, schema version, network ID, deployment, message ID, payload hash and payload.

key_types.name: NetCommand
key_types.what: Commands the crate sends to the swarm: gossip publish, dial, DHT store, put, get, remove, requests.

key_types.name: NetEvent
key_types.what: Swarm output stream: gossip and document ingress, DHT results, incoming requests, peer events.

key_types.name: DocumentPublishedNotification
key_types.what: Small gossip message that names a DHT document by its key, with its metadata (E3, party filter, expiry).

read_first.why: The entry point: wires the startup buffer, sync manager, publisher, translator and converter around the swarm.
The libp2p behaviours the swarm combines, with the gossip and DHT settings.
Wire majors; the gossip topic and sync protocol names that peers must match.
How a publish request becomes a DHT store, a gossip notice and an upload.
How an accepted gossip event passes the allowlist and reaches the bus.

rust_patterns.note: DocumentPublisher implements actix Actor; started runs when the actor starts.
The translator implements Handler for the bus event type it receives.
A private message type that carries a publication key into the actor.
A tokio task forwards broadcast NetEvents into the actor mailbox.
derive(NetworkBehaviour) generates the combined swarm event type.
DirectRequester is configured with retries and timeouts for each peer source of a history fetch.

units.tests: Unit tests inside crates/net/src (cargo test -p e3-net). Integration tests in crates/net/tests (cargo test -p e3-net --test network_isolation, --test configured_peer_reconnect, --test peer_id_mismatch). The Docker scenario is crates/net/tests/run.sh.
unverified: No Kademlia bootstrap query runs in non-test code. Discovery uses configured addresses and Identify-admitted connections; random-walk discovery was not traced.
The swarm start loop and process_swarm_event in net_interface.rs were sampled, not read end to end.
recover_document_state in document_publishing/recovery.rs was located, but its replay logic was not read.

units.one_line: Restart catch-up: checks schema and role markers, replays the event log after snapshot cursors, merges chain and peer history, then re-enables effects.

state.name: per-aggregate cursors: sequence, block and HLC timestamp
request-router checkpoint with its replay cursors
replay spool: sorted runs in temporary files, deleted on every exit path
historical EVM events collected before the merge

key_types.name: SyncRepositoryFactory
key_types.what: Typed repository keys for the schema, role, cursor and checkpoint records.

key_types.name: SnapshotMeta
key_types.what: Per-aggregate cursors, converted to the EVM start config and the net sync cursor.

key_types.name: AggregateState
key_types.what: One aggregate's last sequence, block and HLC timestamp.

key_types.name: ReplaySpool
key_types.what: Post-snapshot EventStore pages written to sorted runs, then merged by HLC for replay.

key_types.name: SyncPlanner
key_types.what: Pure rules: which events replay, which are skipped, the net sync cursor and the timestamp sort.

key_types.name: NodeRole
key_types.what: Full or bootstrap; a data directory stamped for one role halts a start with the other.

key_types.name: SCHEMA_VERSION
key_types.what: The on-disk schema version this binary accepts (8); an older or newer marker halts startup.

key_types.name: HistoricalEvmCollector
key_types.what: Tracks which expected chains have reported their historical EVM events.

read_first.why: The startup sequence in order: preflight, cursors, replay, history, then effects.
The production caller: NetReady is armed before networking starts, then sync runs.
The schema check that runs before any state is written.
The replay loop: fan-out of each merged event, then a barrier.
The replay filter: infrastructure events are never replayed.

rust_patterns.note: The whole startup sequence is one async function that the builder awaits.
Waits for the peer-history result or the fetch failure, whichever arrives first.
Unwraps the expected event variant or fails with a message.
The schema decision is matched on the persisted version and the existing-state flag.
Folds the newest HLC timestamp per aggregate across the historical events.
An async test on the actix runtime that publishes events and replays them.

units.tests: Inline unit tests in replay_spool.rs, state.rs, workflow.rs, node_role.rs, schema_version.rs and collect_history.rs, plus crates/sync/src/sync/tests/ (gates, history, replay, role, schema). Run: cargo test -p e3-sync.

The writers of the aggregate cursors and of the request-router checkpoint are outside this crate and were not read.
The chain side that answers HistoricalEvmSyncStart was not read.
